title: Logging and reproduction
current_gap: The existing JSONL offline replay does not complete the full recording system: bag and FC-native log integration, a complete event stream, deterministic re-simulation, capacity/retention policy and cross-platform determinism are not accepted.

atoms.name: offline_replay
atoms.required: Read-only replay of stopped experiments with raw rows, hashes and diagnostics; closed #16 slice is CLI/JSON review, not re-simulation

atoms.name: source_receive_time
atoms.required: Per-record source time with explicit timebase plus receive time; unmapped cross-timebase identity stays unknown

atoms.name: bag_and_fc_native_logs
atoms.required: Bag recording and FC-native log binding to run identity in one record manifest

atoms.name: complete_event_stream
atoms.required: Whole-system event stream with ordering and identity; bounded task event records are subsets

atoms.name: resimulation
atoms.required: Deterministic re-simulation from records with numerical budget; replay alone cannot prove it

atoms.name: capacity_gap_policy
atoms.required: Capacity/rotation/retention and missing-segment policy; 64 MiB single-file cap with rejection is one rule

scope_rule: replayed acceptance or ACK text is never rewritten into action completion; replay of a record is not re-simulation

followups.blocked_by: FC native log location and identity schema

files: physics source reserved after numerical budget

preserved.resimulation: explicitly out of scope of the replay tool
